title: Woza uzohlala nami
description: UGogo kaTendai uFudu usezilimaze igobolondo kanti umama nobaba kumele bahambe bayomsiza. “Woza uzohlala nami,” kusho umngani omkhulu kaTendai uNogwaja uBusi, buqale lapho-ke ubumnandi.
